yt_title: 1997 Defender 110 300Tdi in Arles Blue: reader rig from Riverhouse Land Rover
yt_description:
Riverhouse Land Rover in the Netherlands sent us this 1997 Defender 110 Station Wagon: matching-numbers 300Tdi, rebuilt axle ends, nine seats, air conditioning and Apple CarPlay. It's a dealer's truck and it's for sale; this isn't a paid feature.

Full story and photos: https://boxytrucks.com/field-notes/reader-rig-riverhouse-defender-110/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social

Footage and photos: Riverhouse Land Rover (@riverhouselandrover on Instagram).
yt_comment: The part we like most is the order they did it in: engine service, axle ends, brakes and suspension first, the screen last. If you're looking at any 300Tdi, ask which timing belt kit went in. Land Rover revised the tensioner, idler and bottom pulley because the early belts wore out. Would you keep a Defender stock inside, or is CarPlay fair game? Full story and photos: https://boxytrucks.com/field-notes/reader-rig-riverhouse-defender-110/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=comment
ig_caption:
Show Us Your Rig: a 1997 Defender 110 Station Wagon in Arles Blue, sent in by @riverhouselandrover in the Netherlands.

It came up from Córdoba in southern Spain with its matching-numbers 300Tdi. The engine has been serviced with a new timing belt, the axle ends were rebuilt with new hubs, bearings and brakes, and it has new shocks and springs. Inside: nine seats, heated fronts, air conditioning and CarPlay.

It's a dealer's truck and it's for sale. Not a paid post; we just like how it was built.

Full story and photos at the link in our bio. Got a boxy truck? boxytrucks.com/submit

Footage and photos: @riverhouselandrover
